test_heuristics_evaluate_state: test the heuristics.evaluate_state function to evaluate a game state for a specified player
test_simulate_random_game: test the simulate_random_game function to run a random game simulation on a pyspiel game
test_minimax_chess: test the minimax alpha_beta_search with heuristics.evaluate_state as value function for chess
test_heuristic_callback: test the heuristics.HEURISTIC_CALLBACKS dictionary to verify heuristic callbacks for loaded games
test_evaluate_state_chess: test the evaluate_state_chess function to compute chess board piece-value heuristic for a player
